description_en: Configures the protection status of domain names in batches
description_zh: 调用BatchSetDcdnWafDomainConfigs批量设置域名防护状态
name: BatchSetDcdnWafDomainConfigs

parameters.help_en: The domain names for which you want to modify the protection status. You can specify up to 50 domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 需修改防护状态域名，最多输入50个，多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: domain_names

parameters.help_en:
The protection status of the domain name. Valid values: on, off, and empty.

When you add a domain name, set the value to on. In this case, the ClientIpTag parameter takes effect. If you select the default header, leave ClientIpTag empty. If you select a custom header, set ClientIpTag to the corresponding value.
When you remove a domain name, set the value to off. In this case, the ClientIpTag parameter does not take effect.
When you only modify the ClientIpTag parameter, leave DefenseStatus empty
parameters.help_zh:
防护域名状态，取值：on、off、和空值。

接入域名时为on，此时ClientIpTag的值生效（选默认时为空；选自定义Header时为对应的值）。
删除域名时为off，此时ClientIpTag不生效。
只修改ClientIpTag时，DefenseStatus为空
parameters.name: defense_status

parameters.help_en: The specified header used to obtain the IP address. If you select the default header, leave this parameter empty. If you select a custom header, set this parameter to the custom value. Separate multiple values with commas (,). You can specify up to 5 values
parameters.help_zh: 指定的获取IP的Header值，当选择默认Header时，该值为空；选择自定义Header时，该值为用户输入的值。传多个值时需要使用逗号分隔，最多5个
parameters.name: client_ip_tag
